start.content: Twenty pieces of silver would have fed a family for months. I said it quietly at first — "Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?" Three hundred — the weight of a slave's life in this city. The perfume was expensive. The gesture — unnecessary.

choices.text: You were concerned for the poor.
Why did you object so strongly?
What did Lazarus's raising have to do with it?

concern_claim.content:
Concern for the poor! Of course it was. I have walked these streets and seen children eat dust while the Temple priests count coins. Three hundred denarii — that is not a trifle to waste on perfume when children cry for bread in the alleys behind the temple courts.
# UNLOCK_EVIDENCE: evidence_judas_motive_exposed

choices.text: The money could have done much.

what_he_said.content: "For you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have me. She has done a beautiful thing to me — for she prepared me for the burial." He said it was for His burial! Not celebration, but preparation for death.

plan_forming.content:
=== plan_forming ==
The plan began forming — not that night, but weeks before. The money bag was not the only thing I could offer the high priest. Information was more valuable than silver. Access was more valuable than coins.
